build_trial_shortname: build a short hyperparameter name string from a params dict using TrialShortNamer.shortname
parse_trial_repr: parse a TrialShortNamer shortname representation back into a full parameters dict
set_trial_defaults: set the prefix and default values for TrialShortNamer hyperparameter naming
add_param_name: add a new parameter name to the TrialShortNamer naming info mapping
build_naming_info: build the internal short word and short param name mappings for TrialShortNamer
